cards.t: Binance Reopens Withdrawals Starting With Bitcoin Following Hack
cards.b: Binance has begun phased crypto withdrawals starting with Bitcoin following a record $6.3 billion exploit. The exchange reports replacing 90% of stolen assets and seeing $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening.

per.BTC: Bitcoin leads the first phase of reopened withdrawals on Binance.
per.BNB: BNB holds near $700 following the exchange hack and replenishment efforts.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact timeline for remaining token withdrawal phases.

cards.t: US Spot Ethereum ETFs Log Record 23-Day Outflow Streak
cards.b: US spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows for 23 straight trading days, marking the longest streak since launch and contributing to price weakness.

per.ETH: ETH faces downward pressure amid consecutive record ETF outflows.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total cumulative capital outflows over the entire 23-day period.
